proposal.summary: The report describes an authenticated SQL injection in College Management System 1.0 via the 'course_code' POST parameter to /admin/asign-single-student-subjects.php, enabling retrieval or modification of database data using SQLMap.
proposal.cwe_quote: College Management System 1.0 allows SQL Injection via parameter 'course_code' in /College-Management-System/admin/asign-single-student-subjects.php.

C.quote: Exploiting this issue could allow an attacker to compromise the application, access or modify data, or exploit latent vulnerabilities in the underlying database.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the injection against a test instance: intercept a valid authenticated POST to asign-single-student-subjects.php, confirm injectable behavior of course_code with boolean or UNION payloads, and capture database responses. If confirmed, identify affected SQL statements and implement parameterized queries or proper input validation; prepare coordinated disclosure to vendor.
